title: Ads every 5-10 seconds
body: It is very disturbing that ads popped up when you are focusing on logging your actions and achievements. I liked this app at the beginning and had the patience for random ads. But I got really fed up with this apps because I am constantly being disturbed like every 5 seconds for ads basically nothing benefits me. I decided to quit after using it for about 2 months when I realised I can’t even type and think in peace. I would rather watching ads for more features or unlock special features.
author: Ads every 5 sec you can’t type

title: no annoying ads and free!
